name: 龙井 / 碧螺春, 绿茶
description: Delicate green teas turn bitter and astringent very quickly; even a few extra minutes ruins them.

name: 白茶
description: Subtle and fragile, continuous steeping destroys the delicate flavour profile.

name: 高山乌龙 / 清香型乌龙
description: The floral lightness gets overwhelmed; roasted 乌龙 is more forgiving but still not ideal.

name: Gyokuro
description: One of the most delicate Japanese green teas, extremely sensitive to both temperature and steep time.

name: Darjeeling first flush
description: Prized precisely for its delicate muscatel character, which disappears with over-steeping.
